title: Bluesky Spam Account Classifier
summary: A student project that classifies Bluesky accounts as spam using a scikit-learn decision tree trained on features extracted from Firehose and profile data. Its analysis_helpers.py uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic per-class samples for balancing the training data.
evidence: analysis_helpers.py:391,407-409 uses `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer` and `synthesizer.fit/sample` to balance classes
